explain: The business mutation and outbox event must commit together. The dispatcher may deliver more than once, so the receiving effect still needs idempotency.
steps: Insert the record and event in one SQLite transaction. || Verify that both are present after commit.
name: transactional-outbox

explain: A lease can expire while its worker continues running. The authoritative write compares a fencing token and rejects the stale worker at commit time.
steps: Advance ownership from token 7 to token 8. || Require the submitted token to match the authoritative current token in the guarded write.
name: fencing

explain: Lease release must compare the owner token before deleting. A worker that lost ownership must not erase its replacement's lease.
steps: Read the current lease token. || Delete only if it still belongs to the releasing worker.
name: compare-delete

explain: A bounded failure becomes visible in a dead-letter record. Replay uses a new attempt identity while preserving the business operation key.
steps: Preserve input identity and failure reason after attempts are exhausted. || Construct a replay attempt without creating a new intended business effect.
name: dead-letter

explain: Sync needs durable checkpoints and shutdown recovery in addition to one ingestion run. The next worker resumes acknowledged work and reclaims expired ownership.
steps: Record a safe checkpoint before shutdown. || Detect that the old lease has expired and resume the unfinished stage.
name: sync-lifecycle

explain: Compare-and-swap publishes only if the active manifest still matches the expected old generation. Document-level and collection-level activation use different scope keys.
steps: Read the expected manifest generation. || Reject an activation based on a stale expectation.
name: compare-activate

explain: Metadata-only updates can avoid re-embedding when content and representation profile stay unchanged. Access changes must still affect query eligibility immediately.
steps: Compare content and embedding identities. || Detect a changed owner without changing the vector representation.
name: metadata-only
